stratum.intro: Most AI transformations fail not because of the technology, but because of human and organizational factors: solutions designed without the people doing the work, built without IT involvement, and deployed without any way to measure what changed. STRATUM is our answer to that. It is a seven-layer AI transformation methodology that addresses every failure mode, in sequence, with nothing skipped.

layers.scan: Multi-level discovery across leadership and knowledge workers, not just the top.
layers.target: User-centered solution design with confidence and irreversibility gating.
layers.resolve: IT as a co-designer in every solution, with a formal AI Governance milestone after Quick Wins.
layers.activate: Phased deployment inside the tools teams already use. Quick Wins first.
layers.transfer: Role-specific AI fluency so teams own their AI, not just use it.
layers.uplift: ROI measured against baselines set at the start, not estimated after.
layers.multiply: Long-horizon strategic bets built on a proven foundation.

showcase.body: One of the outcomes STRATUM unlocks: instant, plain-English access to live data across the tools your teams already use. No dashboards to learn, no analysts in the loop, no exports. Just answers, with the reasoning attached.
showcase.b1: Reads directly from your connected systems
showcase.b2: Shows confidence and reasoning, not just numbers
showcase.b3: Defers to a human when the answer is unclear

quickWins.title: Quick Wins first
quickWins.description: We start with high-confidence, high-reversibility value in 60 to 90 days. That credibility funds everything that comes after.

limits.title: AI that knows its limits
limits.description: Every system we build has a confidence threshold. When the data is insufficient or the right action is unclear, it defers to a human instead of guessing.

problem.title: Scaling bottlenecks
problem.description: ISAs spent too much time qualifying leads and manually compiling apartment suggestions. Invoicing and follow-up consumed hours of founder time monthly.

solution.title: End-to-end automation
solution.description: Automated core ISA tasks, built an AI-powered apartment suggestion bot, streamlined invoicing workflows, and trained founders on AI integration.

results.title: Operational transformation
results.description: Dramatically reduced ISA friction, near-instant apartment recommendations, fully automated invoicing, and a stronger operational backbone.

problem.title: Operational chaos
problem.description: Multiple contacts tied to a single property caused repeated calls. Buyer outreach was delayed by manual processes, and founders lacked hot lead visibility.

solution.title: Intelligent systems
solution.description: Built a deduplication system for the dialer queue, automated buyer outreach triggered on contract, and implemented real-time hot lead notifications.

results.title: Streamlined deal flow
results.description: Duplicate seller calls reduced to near zero, buyer outreach 60–75% faster, and founders gained immediate visibility into high-intent leads.

problem.title: Infrastructure, not effort
problem.description: Tools didn't talk to each other and data lived in silos. Founders spent their days chasing updates, vehicles sat idle without visibility, invoices aged for weeks, and 3–4 hours daily were lost to manual logging and reporting.

solution.title: STRATUM Brain deployment
solution.description: Deployed an agentic intelligence layer with four core agents (Fleet, Revenue & Bookings, Payments, and Operations) unified under a central registry with confidence-tiered autonomy and on-demand plain-English querying.

results.title: From operators to executives
results.description: +23% fleet utilization, 60% reduction in daily admin hours, 18-day cut in payment collection cycle, 2 hours/day reclaimed for founders, and zero additional hires needed to absorb the scale-up.
